preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 10**5 and 1 <= x <= n for n, x in [tuple(map(int, stdin.split()))])
preconditions.description: Input must contain two integers n (number of boxes) and x (last box index) where 2 ≤ n ≤ 10^5 and 1 ≤ x ≤ n.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(0 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a) and a[x-1] != 0
preconditions.description: The second line must contain exactly n integers a_1, ..., a_n where each 0 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^9 and a_x ≠ 0 (since x is the last box to receive a ball).

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= b_i <= 10**9 for b_i in b) and len(b) == n
postconditions.description: Output must be a list of n non-negative integers b_1, ..., b_n representing the initial number of balls in each box.

postconditions.expression: all(a_i == b_i + (sum(1 for j in range(i, n) if (j - i) % n == k) if i != x else sum(1 for j in range(i, n) if (j - i) % n == k) - 1) for i in range(1, n+1))
postconditions.description: The output b must satisfy the condition that after redistributing balls from box x (where x is the last box to receive a ball), the resulting counts match the given a. Specifically, for each box i, the final count a_i is equal to the initial count b_i plus the number of balls redistributed into it (modular arithmetic for circular distribution).

The total number of balls in the initial configuration b must equal the total number of balls in the final configuration a, adjusted by the fact that the balls redistributed from box x (counted as a[x-1]) are now distributed into other boxes.
